source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: Poke with Hellfire, then Web Lash to root and follow with Crushing Maw up close to heal and build Hunger. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, chase with Consume when they are low enough to be bitten and executed.
offlane.issue: Consume slows Akeron and pulls; it is not a chase tool
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Hellfire, then Web Lash to root and follow with Crushing Maw up close to heal and build Hunger. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, use Consume to pull a low target in and bite them for the execute.

support.quote: Wait for their engage, then lob Dread Nova to stun and place Ether Crystal under your carry to lift them away and pull enemies in. Once Stonewall lands, stand closer and channel Synaptic Obliterator after the enemy uses their dashes.
support.issue: Ether Crystal lifts allies into the air, it does not move them away; the implosion pulls enemies to the center where your carry stands
support.rewrite: Wait for their engage, then lob Dread Nova to stun and place Ether Crystal under your carry to push divers off and lift your carry into the air. Once Stonewall lands, stand closer and channel Synaptic Obliterator after the enemy uses their dashes.

jungle.quote: Gank with Reaping Dash, then Hamstring on a single target to slow and hit harder, holding Safeguard to block their key ability. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish with Earth Shatter to execute and recast it after a takedown.
jungle.issue: Earth Shatter recast needs an executed Enemy Hero, not any takedown
jungle.rewrite: Gank with Reaping Dash, then Hamstring on a single target to slow and hit harder, holding Safeguard to block their key ability. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish with Earth Shatter to execute and recast it after executing a hero.

midlane.quote: Black Hole roots you in place while channeling; cast it only after the enemy has used their dashes and stuns.
midlane.issue: Black Hole is a channel, not a root on Gideon; wording misdescribes the ability
midlane.rewrite: Black Hole keeps you channeling for 2.75s before you can act; cast it only after the enemy has used their dashes and stuns.

carry.quote: Drop H11 Cluster Grenades to slow them, lob Land Mine behind them to stun them, then charge R2000 Missile while they're stuck. Once Combustion and Orion land, weave basic attacks between abilities so Armed Salvo refills your mana and keeps the rotation going.
carry.issue: Land Mine knocks back and stuns only 0.5s, far shorter than R2000 Missile's 1.3s hover plus charge, so targets are not 'stuck' for it
carry.rewrite: Drop H11 Cluster Grenades to slow them and lob Land Mine to knock them back and stun, then poke with R2000 Missile from range. Once Combustion and Orion land, weave basic attacks between abilities so Armed Salvo refills your mana and keeps the rotation going.

jungle.quote: If Judgement of the Heavens misses, you have no gap closer left; walk away instead of face-tanking the whole enemy team.
jungle.issue: false: Surge of the Heavens is still a dash and the thrown blade stays in the world for Fury of the Heavens to teleport to
jungle.rewrite: If Judgement of the Heavens misses, keep Surge of the Heavens to get out instead of face-tanking the whole enemy team.

carry.quote: Fire Saturation Charge to slow them, cook Frag Order to launch them, then hold fire on K-75 Storm Rifle while they're stuck. Once Sky Splitter and Spectra are done, drop Rally Point so your team moves faster, and aim Orbital Sanction at whoever runs.
carry.issue: 'hold fire' reads as stop shooting, and Frag Order launches rather than holds targets in place
carry.rewrite: Fire Saturation Charge to slow them, cook Frag Order to launch them, then keep shooting K-75 Storm Rifle while they're slowed. Once Sky Splitter and Spectra are done, drop Rally Point so your team moves faster, and aim Orbital Sanction at whoever runs.

offlane.quote: Dash in with First Intent, lock the target with Swan Song, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs while they can't move. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, aim your combo at squishy targets, not the enemy frontline.
offlane.issue: Swan Song's restrain lasts only through Scarlett's own backflip strike, so follow-ups don't land while they're held
offlane.rewrite: Dash in with First Intent, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs, and use Swan Song to restrain a target that tries to run; your blade stays Ablaze afterward for extra stabs. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, aim your combo at squishy targets, not the enemy frontline.

jungle.quote: Gank from behind with First Intent, lock the target with Swan Song, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs while they're held. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, hunt squishy laners instead of fighting the frontline head-on.
jungle.issue: Swan Song's restrain lasts only through Scarlett's own backflip strike, so follow-ups don't land while they're held
jungle.rewrite: Gank from behind with First Intent, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs, and use Swan Song to restrain a target that tries to run; your blade stays Ablaze afterward for extra stabs. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, hunt squishy laners instead of fighting the frontline head-on.

offlane.quote: Trade with Highland Hurl to slow, then Ruthless Assault up close to stack Hersir and land the empowered basic attack. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, engage with Wild Rush and use Unstoppable Force to cleanse and push enemy towers.
offlane.issue: max Hersir empowers Terra's next basic ability, not a basic attack
offlane.rewrite: Trade with Highland Hurl to slow, then Ruthless Assault up close to stack Hersir so your next ability is empowered. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, engage with Wild Rush and use Unstoppable Force to cleanse and disable enemy towers while you push.

jungle.quote: Gank by dashing in with Windsurge, then use Cyclebreaker's damage reduction as they fight back and switch stance with 84000 Hairs to keep spawning clones. After The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation by minute 16, hunt squishy targets.
jungle.issue: clones spawn from damaging enemies 5 times, not from switching stance
jungle.rewrite: Gank by dashing in with Windsurge, then use Cyclebreaker's damage reduction as they fight back; every 5 hits on enemies spawns a clone, and 84000 Hairs switches your stance. After The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation by minute 16, hunt squishy targets.

offlane.quote: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, and use Infuse on yourself to stay healthy between trades. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
offlane.issue: Infuse targets an Ally per the source; self-healing is not supported
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, then back off between trades instead of trading health. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.

midlane.quote: Clear the wave with Bad Medicine, then poke with Ricochet when it can bounce off minions into them, and keep yourself healthy with Infuse. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 15, join side-lane fights.
midlane.issue: Infuse targets an Ally per the source; self-healing is not supported
midlane.rewrite: Clear the wave with Bad Medicine, then poke with Ricochet when it can bounce off minions into them. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 15, join side-lane fights.
